shots.narration_dhivehi: ޝިމާގެ ޙަޔާތަކީ ހުވަފެނީ ދުނިޔެއެކޭ ބުންޏަސް ދޮގަކަށް ނުވާނެ. މާލޭގެ މަތީ ފަންތީގެ، ތަނަވަސް ޢާއިލާއަކަށް ނިސްބަތްވާ ޝިމާއަކީ އޭނާގެ މައިންބަފައިންގެ ހުރި ހަމައެކަނި ދަރިފުޅު.
shots.narration_english: To say that Shima's life was a dream world would be no lie. Belonging to a wealthy upper-class family of Male, Shima is her parents' one and only child.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ޚާއްޞަކޮށް އޭނާގެ ބައްޕަ، ޤާސިމްގެ ފުރާނައާ ގުޅިފައިވާ އެންމެ އަގުބޮޑު ޖަވާހިރަކީ އެއީ. ޤާސިމަކީ މުޖުތަމަޢުގައި ނުހަނު ޤަދަރުވެރި، ނަމަވެސް މިޒާޖުގައި ވަރަށް ހަރުކަށި، އުސޫލުތަކަށް ބޯލަނބާ މީހެއް.
shots.narration_english: Above all, she is the most precious jewel bound to the very soul of her father, Qasim. Qasim is a man greatly respected in society, but very rigid in temperament and stubborn about his principles.

shots.narration_dhivehi: މީހުންގެ ތެރޭގައި އޭނާގެ ނަމާއި ޢިއްޒަތަކީ އޭނާ އެންމެ ބޮޑަށް ފަޚުރުވެރިވާ ކަންތައްތައް. ޝިމާ ބޮޑުވަމުން އައީ އެ ބައްޕަގެ ހަރުދަނާ، އަދި ބައެއް ފަހަރު ހާސްކަން ގެނުވާފަދަ ހަރުކަށި ތަރުބިއްޔަތުގެ ދަށުން.
shots.narration_english: His name and honour among people are what he is proudest of. Shima grew up under that father's firm, and at times stifling, strict upbringing.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެހެންނަމަވެސް އޭނާއަށް އެއްވެސް ކަމަކަށް ދަތިވިޔަކަ ނުދޭ. ބޭނުންވި ކޮންމެ އެއްޗެއް، އެދުނު ކޮންމެ ކަމެއް ވަގުތުން ފުރިހަމަވޭ.
shots.narration_english: Even so, she was never denied anything. Whatever she needed, whatever she wished for, was fulfilled at once.

beats.mood: bright soft daylight through tall windows, warm marble interior, comfortable and wealthy, a quiet undertone of strictness
beats.visual: Shima with her cream hijab fully covering her hair and neck laughing radiantly while arranging white flowers in a vase on the low table; her mother Naseema in her grey-patterned dark dress with her dark navy hijab fully covering her hair and neck standing beside her, watching her daughter with a soft loving smile, a hand on Shima's shoulder; sunlight through the sheer curtains

shots.narration_dhivehi: އުމުރުން ވިހި އަހަރު ފުރުނުއިރު ޝިމާއަކީ ރީތިކަމާއި އަޚުލާޤުގެ ގޮތުން ނަމޫނާ ކުއްޖެއްގެ ގޮތުގައި މުޅި ޢާއިލާވެސް ފާހަގަކުރާ ކުއްޖެއް.
shots.narration_english: By the time she turned twenty, Shima was a girl the whole family singled out as a model of beauty and good character.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާގެ ފުޅާ ހިނިތުންވުމުން މުޅި ގޭތެރެއަށް ދިރުން ގެނެސްދޭ. ޝިމާގެ މަންމަ، ނަސީމާއަކީ މަޑުމައިތިރި އަންހެނެއް.
shots.narration_english: Her wide smile brought life to the whole house. Shima's mother, Naseema, is a gentle, soft-spoken woman.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާގެ ދުނިޔެއަކީ ޝިމާގެ އުފާވެރިކަން ކަމުގައި ވެފައިވާއިރު، އެ ގޭގެ ހަތަރު ފާރުގެ ތެރޭގައިވަނީ ފުރިހަމަ އަމާންކަމާއި ރައްކާތެރިކަން.
shots.narration_english: Her whole world was Shima's happiness, and within the four walls of that house there was perfect peace and safety.

beats.new_image_reason: emotional turning point: the narrator foreshadows a great storm over the family
beats.location: the outside of Qasim's wealthy modern multi-storey house in a narrow Male lane: pale walls, tall windows, a heavy dark front gate, neighbouring pastel buildings, parked motorbikes along the lane
beats.mood: bruised dusk, dark heavy storm clouds gathering over the city, a cold wind, ominous foreboding
beats.visual: the wealthy multi-storey house seen from the narrow lane at dusk, one warm lit upper window, while enormous dark storm clouds roll in over the Male skyline behind it; the heavy dark front gate closed; nobody in the lane; no signs, no lettering
beats.camera: wide establishing shot, low angle from the lane, the house and the storm clouds in the upper two-thirds, the empty lane as the lower third
beats.safe_substitution: foreshadowing shown as gathering storm clouds over the house

shots.narration_dhivehi: ނަމަވެސް އެ ފުރިހަމަ އުފާވެރިކަމުގެ ފަހަތުގައި، މުޅި ޢާއިލާގެ ބިންގާ ރޫޅާލާނެފަދަ ބޮޑު ތޫފާނެއްގެ ހިލަން އެކަކަށްވެސް ނުވޭ.
shots.narration_english: But behind that perfect happiness, no one caught the scent of a great storm that would shake the foundations of the whole family.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ޝިމާގެ މައުސޫމުކަމާއި ދުނިޔެއަށް ހުރި ނޭނގުންތެރިކަމަކީ، އޭނާއަށް ކުރިމަތިވާނެ އެންމެ ބޮޑު ނުރައްކާކަން އޭރު އޭނާއަށް އިޙްސާސެއް ނުކުރެވޭ.
shots.narration_english: Shima's innocence and her ignorance of the world -- she did not sense then that these were the greatest danger she would face.

beats.new_image_reason: scene and character change: at college, charming Yazan is introduced
beats.location: a bright open-air corridor of a college in Male: a long row of pillars, pale walls, a few students far away softly blurred, a green tree in a courtyard
beats.mood: bright airy daylight, fresh and youthful
beats.visual: Yazan in his open light-grey overshirt over a white t-shirt, swept-back hair, leaning casually against a pillar in the bright college corridor, a confident light smile on his lips and a deep dark gaze towards the camera; a few students far away and softly blurred
beats.camera: medium close-up, eye level, his face in the upper half, the pale corridor floor as the lower third

shots.narration_dhivehi: ޝިމާގެ އަމާން ދިރިއުޅުމަށް ބޮޑު ބަދަލެއް އައީ، ކޮލެޖުގެ މާޙައުލުން ޔަޒަންއާ ބައްދަލުވި ހިސާބުން. ޔަޒަންއަކީ އުމުރުން ބާވީސް އަހަރުގެ، ރީތި އަދި ވާހަކަދެއްކުމަށް ނުހަނު ކުޅަދާނަ ޒުވާނެއް.
shots.narration_english: The great change in Shima's safe life came when she met Yazan at college. Yazan is a handsome twenty-two-year-old young man, extraordinarily gifted at talking.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާގެ ލޮލުގައިވާ ފުންކަމާއި، ތުންފަތްމަތީގައިވާ ލުއި ހިނިތުންވުމަކީ ކޮންމެ އަންހެންކުއްޖެއްގެ ހިތްވެސް ލަންބުވާލާފަދަ ޖާދޫއެއް.
shots.narration_english: The depth in his eyes and the light smile on his lips were a magic that could melt any girl's heart.

beats.new_image_reason: scene change: first meeting of eyes in the college library; Yazan starts talking to her
beats.location: a college library: tall wooden bookshelves with plain unlabelled book spines, long reading tables with a few closed books, big windows letting in daylight

beats.visual: in the bright library Shima with her cream hijab fully covering her hair and neck sits at a long reading table with a closed book, looking up shyly with a small surprised smile; Yazan stands across the table on the far side, a full arm's length and more away beside a tall bookshelf, speaking to her with a charming smile; the two clearly apart, not touching; plain unlabelled books
beats.camera: medium wide, eye level, both faces in the upper two-thirds, the reading table top as the lower third
beats.safe_substitution: the growing attraction shown only as glances and talking across a library table at a respectful distance

shots.narration_dhivehi: ފުރަތަމަ ދުވަހު ކޮލެޖުގެ ލައިބްރަރީން ދެމީހުންގެ ލޯ ބައްދަލުވި ހިސާބުން ފެށިގެން، ޝިމާގެ ހިތުގައި އާ ވިންދެއް ޖަހަން ފެށި.
shots.narration_english: From the first day their eyes met in the college library, a new rhythm began to beat in Shima's heart.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ޔަޒަން އަމިއްލައަށް އިސްނަގައިގެން ޝިމާއާ ވާހަކަދައްކަން ފެށި. އޭނާގެ ފޮނި ބަސްތަކާއި، ލޯބިން ފުރިގެންވާ ނަޒަރުތައް ޝިމާގެ ހިތުގެ އެންމެ ފުންމިނަށް ފޯރި.
shots.narration_english: Yazan himself took the lead and began talking to Shima. His sweet words and his looks full of love reached the deepest corner of Shima's heart.

shots.narration_dhivehi: މީގެ ކުރިން ދުވަހަކުވެސް ފިރިހެންކުއްޖަކާ އެހާ ގާތްކޮށް އުޅެފައި ނުވާ ޝިމާއަށް، ޔަޒަންގެ ސަމާލުކަން ވެގެންދިޔައީ އޭނާގެ މުޅި ދުނިޔެ ބަދަލުކޮށްލި ކަމަކަށް.
shots.narration_english: For Shima, who had never before been so close to any boy, Yazan's attention became something that changed her whole world.

beats.visual: Shima alone at night sitting cross-legged on her bed against the headboard, fully dressed in her lavender long dress with her cream hijab fully covering her hair and neck, holding a phone to her ear and smiling dreamily, her eyes shining; the warm bedside lamp beside her; her bed with a pale quilt, the dressing table with a mirror at the right, the window with a sheer curtain at the left; the phone screen not visible
beats.camera: medium shot, eye level, her face in the upper half, the pale quilt as the lower third

shots.narration_dhivehi: ކޮންމެ ދުވަހަކު އެތައް ގަޑިއިރެއް ވަންދެން ފޯނުން ވާހަކަދެއްކުމާއި، ޢާއިލާއަށް ސިއްރުން ބައްދަލުކުރުން ޢާއްމު އާދައަކަށް ވި.
shots.narration_english: Talking on the phone for hours every day, and meeting secretly, hidden from the family, became a habit.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ޔަޒަންދެކެ ޝިމާއަށް ވެވުނީ އާދަޔާ ޚިލާފު މޮޔަ ލޯތްބެއް. އެއީ އޭނާގެ ފުރާނައިގެ އެއްބައި ކަމުގައި ޤަބޫލުކުރެވުނު.
shots.narration_english: What Shima came to feel for Yazan was an extraordinary, foolish love. She came to believe he was a part of her very soul.

beats.new_image_reason: scene change: a secret meeting where Yazan makes sweet promises of marriage
beats.location: a quiet small cafe in Male: a small round wooden table by a big window, two cups of tea on the table, a blurred lane outside
beats.mood: soft warm late-afternoon light, cosy and hopeful
beats.visual: Yazan and Shima sitting opposite each other across a small round wooden table in a quiet cafe, a full arm's length apart, two cups of tea between them; Yazan leaning back slightly, one hand on his chest, speaking earnestly with a persuasive smile; Shima with her cream hijab fully covering her hair and neck listening, entranced and trusting, her hands around her cup; warm window light
beats.camera: medium two-shot from the side, eye level, faces in the upper two-thirds, the table top and cups as the lower third
beats.safe_substitution: romance shown only as two people talking across a table at a respectful distance, never touching

shots.narration_dhivehi: ލޯބީގެ މަސްތުގައި ޖެހި، ޝިމާއަށް ރަނގަޅާއި ނުބައި ވަކިނުވާ ހިސާބަށް ކަންތައްތައް ދިޔަ. ޔަޒަން އޭނާއާއެކު މުޅި އުމުރު ހޭދަކުރާނެ ކަމަށާއި، ކިޔެވުން ނިމުނުހާ އަވަހަކަށް ކައިވެނިކުރާނެ ކަމުގެ އެތައް ފޮނި ވަޢުދެއްވި.
shots.narration_english: Caught up in the intoxication of love, things went so far that Shima could no longer tell right from wrong. Yazan made countless sweet promises that he would spend his whole life with her and marry her as soon as their studies were over.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ޝިމާ އެހުރިހާ ވާހަކަތަކެއް ޤަބޫލުކުރީ އެއްވެސް ޝައްކެއް، ބިރެއް ނެތި. އެ ދޮގުވެރި އަވާގައި ޖެހި، ޝިމާއަށް ކުރެވުނީ އޭނާގެ ޙަޔާތުގައިވެސް ކުރެވޭނެ އެންމެ ބޮޑު ކުށް.
shots.narration_english: Shima believed every one of those words without any doubt or fear. Caught in that deceitful air, Shima made the greatest mistake she could ever make in her life.

beats.visual: Shima in her lavender long dress with her cream hijab fully covering her hair and neck seen from behind and to the side, slipping out through the narrow gap of the heavy dark front gate into the empty lane, glancing back nervously over her shoulder at the dark sleeping house where every window is unlit; orange street light, deep shadows
beats.camera: medium wide, eye level, her figure and the gate in the upper two-thirds, the dark wet asphalt as the lower third
beats.safe_substitution: the secret night meeting is shown only as her leaving the dark house alone

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެރެއަކީ ޤާސިމް ވިޔަފާރި ދަތުރެއްގައި ރަށުންބޭރަށް ގޮސް ހުރި ރެއެއް. މަންމަ ހުރީ ބޮލުގައި ރިއްސާތީ ވަރަށް އަވަހަށް ނިދާފަ.
shots.narration_english: That night Qasim was away from Male on a business trip. Her mother, with a headache, had gone to sleep very early.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ގޭތެރެއަށް ވެރިވެފައިވަނީ ފުން ހިމޭންކަމެއް. ޔަޒަންގެ އެދުމަށް ޝިމާ ސިއްރުސިއްރުން ގެއިން ނުކުމެގެން ގޮސް އޭނާއާ ބައްދަލުކުރަން ދިޔައީ، ޔަޒަންގެ ރަޙުމަތްތެރިއެއްގެ ހުސްކޮށް ހުރި އެޕާޓްމަންޓަކަށް.
shots.narration_english: A deep silence had settled over the house. At Yazan's request, Shima slipped secretly out of the house and went to meet him at an empty apartment belonging to a friend of Yazan's.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެތަނަށް ވަދެވުމާއެކު ޝިމާގެ ހިތް ބިރުން ތެޅެން ފެށި. އަހަރެންދެކެ ލޯބިވަންޏާ އިތުބާރު ކުރާނެ ނޫންހޭ؟
shots.narration_english: The moment she went in there, Shima's heart began to pound with fear. "If you love me, won't you trust me?"

shots.narration_dhivehi: ޔަޒަންގެ ލޯބިން ފުރިގެންވާ ބީހުންތަކާއި، އެހެން ބުނެ ކުރި އާދޭސްތަކުގެ ކުރިމަތީގައި ޝިމާގެ ނަފުސުގެ ހުރިހާ ކޮންޓްރޯލެއް ގެއްލުނު.
shots.narration_english: Before Yazan's words full of love, and the pleading he made as he said it, Shima lost all control over herself.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ޝައިޠާނާގެ ވަސްވާސްތަކުގައި ޖެހި، އިސްލާމްދީނާއި މުޖުތަމަޢު ކަނޑައަޅާފައިވާ ހުރިހާ އިމަކުން އޭނާ ބޭރުވި.
shots.narration_english: Caught in the whispers of Satan, she stepped beyond every boundary set by Islam and by society.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެރޭ އޭނާގެ އެންމެ އަގުބޮޑު ޢިއްފަތްތެރިކަން ޔަޒަންއަށް ޤުރުބާންކުރި. ކުށެއް ކުރެވިއްޖެކަން އިޙްސާސްވީ ވަގުތު ފާއިތުވި ފަހުން.
shots.narration_english: That night she surrendered her most precious chastity to Yazan. She realised she had done wrong only after the moment had passed.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަމިއްލަ ނަފުސަށް ކުރެވުނު ޚިޔާނާތުގެ ބޮޑުކަން އިޙްސާސްވުމާއެކު، ޝިމާއަށް ރޮވެން ފެށުނު. ގެއަށް އައިސް ކޮޓަރިއަށް ވަދެ، އެނދުމައްޗަށް ވެއްޓިގަނެ ޝިމާ ގިސްލަގިސްލާފައި ރުއި.
shots.narration_english: As she felt the enormity of the betrayal she had committed against herself, Shima began to cry. Coming home, she went into her room, threw herself onto the bed and sobbed.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާގެ ހިތް ތެޅެމުންދިޔައީ ބަޔާންކުރަންދަތި ބިރުވެރިކަމެއްގެ ތެރޭގައި. އޭނާގެ ޠާހިރުކަން ނަގާލެވިއްޖެކަމުގެ ކުށުގެ އިޙްސާސުން، އޭނާގެ ނޭވާ ހާސްކުރުވި.
shots.narration_english: Her heart was pounding with a fear beyond words. The guilt of having lost her purity made her breath ragged.

beats.camera: close-up, eye level, her face in the upper half, the pale quilt as the lower third

shots.narration_dhivehi: ނަމަވެސް އެރޭ ޔަޒަން ފޮނުވި މެސެޖުތަކުން އޭނާ ހަމަޖައްސައިދިން. ކައިވެނިކުރާނެކަމުގެ ޔަޤީންކަން ތަކުރާރުކޮށް ދިނުމުން، ޝިމާ އެ ބޮޑު ފާފަ ސިއްރުކޮށް، އަމިއްލަ ނަފުސަށް އޮޅުވާލައިގެން ހިތްހަމަޖައްސާލައިގެން ހުރި.
shots.narration_english: But that night the messages Yazan sent calmed her. As he kept repeating his assurance that he would marry her, Shima hid that great sin, deceived herself and set her heart at rest.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ޤާސިމްގެ މޫނަށް ބަލާލަންވެސް އޭނާ ލަދުގަތް. ނަމަވެސް ލޯބީގެ ކަނުކަމުގައި، އޭނާ އެކަން ހަނދާންނައްތާލަން މަސައްކަތްކުރި.
shots.narration_english: She was ashamed even to look at Qasim's face. But in the blindness of love she tried to forget it.

shots.narration_dhivehi: މަސްތަކެއް ފާއިތުވެގެން ދިޔަ. ޝިމާގެ ހަށިގަނޑަށާއި ޞިއްޙަތަށް އާދަޔާ ޚިލާފު ބަދަލުތަކެއް އަންނަން ފެށި.
shots.narration_english: Months passed. Unusual changes began to come over Shima's body and her health.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ކެއުމާ ދުރުވެ، ހެނދުނު ހޭލާއިރު ބޯއަނބުރައި ހޮޑުލެވޭގޮތް ވާން ފެށި. އޭނާގެ އާއްމު ދިރިއުޅުމުގެ އުސޫލުތަކަށް ބަދަލު އައި.
shots.narration_english: She turned away from food, and on waking in the morning she felt dizzy and sick. Her usual daily routine changed.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ފުރަތަމަ އޭނާ ހީކުރީ އެއީ އާދައިގެ ބައްޔެއް ނުވަތަ ވަރުބަލިކަމެއް ކަމަށް. ނަމަވެސް ދުވަސްތައް ފާއިތުވަމުން ދިޔަވަރަކަށް، އޭނާގެ ހިތުގައި އުފެދުނު ބިރުވެރި ޝައްކުތައް ޔަޤީންކަމަށް ބަދަލުވާން ފެށި.
shots.narration_english: At first she thought it was an ordinary illness or tiredness. But as the days went by, the frightening suspicions in her heart began to turn into certainty.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާގެ މައްސަރު ކަންތައްވެސް ވަނީ މެދުކެނޑިފަ. އެއްދުވަހަކު، މޫނު ނިވާކޮށްގެން، މީހަކަށް ނޭނގޭނެހެން ސިއްރުން ދުރުގައި ހުރި ފާމަސީއަކަށް ގޮސް ޕްރެގްނަންސީ ޓެސްޓެއް ގަނެގެން އައިސް ކޮޓަރީގެ ފާޚާނާއަށް ވަދެ ދޮރު ތަޅުލި.
shots.narration_english: Her monthly period had stopped too. One day, covering her face, secretly so that no one would know, she went to a pharmacy far away, bought a pregnancy test, came back, went into the bathroom of her room and locked the door.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ތުރުތުރުއަޅާ އަތަކުން ޓެސްޓުކޮށްލުމަށްފަހު، އެ ތިން މިނެޓު އޭނާ ހޭދަކުރީ މަރުގެ ތުންފަތްމަތީގައި ހުރި މީހަކު ފަދައިން.
shots.narration_english: After testing with trembling hands, she spent those three minutes like someone standing on the very lips of death.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ލޯމަރައިގެން ހުރެފައި މަޑުމަޑުން ލޯ ހުޅުވާލައި ޓެސްޓު ކިޓަށް ބަލާލި. ދެ ރޮނގު ރަތްކޮށް އަރާފައި ހުރި މަންޒަރު ފެނުމާއެކު، ޝިމާއަށް ހީވީ އޭނާގެ ފައިދަށުން ބިންގަނޑު ދެމިގަތްހެން.
shots.narration_english: Eyes shut, she slowly opened them and looked at the test kit. The moment she saw the two red lines that had appeared, Shima felt as if the ground had given way beneath her feet.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަތުގައި އޮތް ޓެސްޓު ކިޓު ތަޅުމައްޗަށް ވެއްޓުނު. އޭނާއަށް ބާރަށް ރޮއިގަނެވުނު. އަވަސްއަވަހަށް އަނގަމަތީގައި އަތްއަޅައި އަޑު ބޭރަށް ނުދާނެހެން ހިފެހެއްޓި.
shots.narration_english: The test kit in her hand fell to the floor. She burst into loud sobs, and quickly clamped her hand over her mouth to keep the sound from getting out.

shots.narration_dhivehi: މުޅި ދުނިޔެ އެނބުރި، އޭނާއަށް ބަނަވެގެން ދިޔަ. ކުރެވުނު ފާފައިގެ ބޮޑުކަމާއި، އޭގެ ނަތީޖާ ކުރިމަތިން ފެންނަން އޮތުމުން އޭނާގެ ނޭވާ ހާސްވާގޮތްވި.
shots.narration_english: The whole world spun and she grew dizzy. With the enormity of the sin she had committed and its consequence there before her, she could hardly breathe.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާގެ ބަނޑުގައި ޙަރާމް ދަރިއަކު އުފެދެމުންދާކަން އެނގުމުން، އޭނާގެ ސިކުނޑި ސުމަކަށް ދިޔަ. މިހެން ނުވާނެ... މިއީ ހުވަފެނެއް...
shots.narration_english: Knowing that a child of sin was forming in her womb, her mind went blank. "This can't happen... This is a dream...

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެހެންނަމަވެސް، ޙަޤީޤަތަކީ ފޮރުވޭނެ އެއްޗެއް ނޫން. ކޮންމެވެސް އެއްދުވަހަކުން ފަޅާއަރާނެ ބޮޑު ސިއްރެއް. އެއީ މާލެއަށް ބޯކޮށް ވާރޭވެހެމުންދިޔަ ބިރުވެރި ރޭގަނޑެއް.
shots.narration_english: Even so, the truth is not something that can be hidden. It is a great secret that will burst open one day. It was a frightening night, with heavy rain pouring down on Male.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އުޑުމަތި ގުގުރަމުންދިޔަ އަޑުން، މުޅި މާލެތެރެ ސިއްސުވާލާ. ވިދާލާ ވިދުވަރުގެ އަލިން ކޮޓަރިތެރެ އަލިވެގެންދޭ.
shots.narration_english: The rumble of thunder across the sky made all of Male shudder. Flashes of lightning lit up the room.

beats.new_image_reason: scene change: in her storm-lit room she weeps over hundreds of unanswered messages
beats.location: Shima's bedroom in the wealthy house on a stormy night: a bed with a pale quilt, a dressing table with a mirror at the right, a window with a sheer curtain at the left with rain streaming down the glass, the bedroom door to the hallway
beats.mood: near-black blue storm night inside the room, a dim warm lamp, the cold glow of a phone, white lightning flashes through the window, dread
beats.visual: Shima curled on top of her bed in her lavender long dress with her cream hijab fully covering her hair and neck, crying, her face lit by the cold glow of the phone in her hands, the screen turned away and not visible; rain streaming down the window at the left, a white lightning flash lighting the room; the bedroom door at the back closed
beats.camera: medium shot, eye level, her face in the upper half, the pale quilt as the lower third
beats.safe_substitution: phone shown only as a glow on her face, no readable screen

shots.narration_dhivehi: ޝިމާ ކޮޓަރީގައި އޮވެ ގިސްލަގިސްލާފައި ރޮމުންދަނިކޮށް، އޭނާގެ ފޯނަށް މެސެޖެއް އައިތޯ ބަލާލުމަށް ފޯނު ހުޅުވާލި.
shots.narration_english: As Shima lay in her room sobbing, she opened her phone to see whether any message had come.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާ އޮތީ ޔަޒަންއަށް ފޮނުވާފައިވާ، ޖަވާބު ނުލިބޭ އެތައް ސަތޭކަ މެސެޖުތަކެއް ކިޔަން. ކުއްލިއަކަށް ކޮޓަރީގެ ދޮރު ހުޅުވިގެން ދިޔައީ ޤާސިމް.
shots.narration_english: She lay reading the hundreds of messages she had sent Yazan that got no answer. Suddenly the door of the room opened -- it was Qasim.

beats.new_image_reason: character/action change: Qasim bursts in, takes the phone and reads the messages
beats.location: Shima's bedroom in the wealthy house on a stormy night: a bed with a pale quilt, a dressing table with a mirror at the right, a window with a sheer curtain at the left with rain streaming down the glass, the bedroom door to the hallway
beats.mood: near-black blue storm night inside the room, a dim warm lamp, the cold glow of a phone, white lightning flashes through the window, dread
beats.visual: Qasim in his white shirt standing in the middle of the dark storm-lit bedroom holding Shima's phone, its cold glow lighting his stern face from below as he reads, his expression darkening in disbelief; the screen faces away from the camera and is not visible; behind him on the bed, frozen in terror, Shima with her cream hijab fully covering her hair and neck with both hands pressed to her mouth; lightning in the window
beats.camera: medium shot, eye level, Qasim's face centred in the upper half, Shima softer behind, the floor as the lower third
beats.safe_substitution: 'snatched the phone from her hand' is not shown: the phone is already in his hand, no contact

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާ އައީ ޝިމާގެ ކޮޓަރިން ރޯ އަޑު އިވިގެން. ޝިމާގެ ހާސްކަމާއި، ފޯނު ފޮރުވަން އުޅުނުގޮތް ފެނި ޤާސިމްގެ ހިތުގައި ޝައްކުތަކެއް އުފެދުނު.
shots.narration_english: He had come because he heard crying from Shima's room. Seeing Shima's panic and the way she tried to hide the phone, suspicions arose in Qasim's heart.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ވަގުތުން ގޮސް ޝިމާގެ އަތުން ފޯނު ޖަހައިގަތް. އަދި އޭގައިވާ މެސެޖުތައް ކިޔަން ފެށި.
shots.narration_english: He went straight over, snatched the phone from Shima's hand and began to read the messages in it.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެ މެސެޖުތަކުގައި ޝިމާ އޭނާ ބަލިވެއިން ވާހަކައާއި، ޔަޒަންއަށް އާދޭސްކޮށްފައިވާ ވާހަކަތައް، އަދި އޭނާގެ ބަނޑުގައިވާ ދަރިފުޅަށް ރަޙުމްކުރުމަށް އެދިފައިވާ ވާހަކަތައް ސާފުކޮށް ހުރި.
shots.narration_english: In those messages it was all there, plain to see: Shima saying she was pregnant, her pleading with Yazan, and her begging him to have mercy on the child in her womb.

shots.narration_dhivehi: މީގެ އިތުރުން ޝިމާގެ ޑްރެސިންގ ޓޭބަލް މަތީގައި އޮތް، އުކާލަން ނުކެރިފައިވާ ޕްރެގްނަންސީ ޓެސްޓު ކިޓުވެސް ޤާސިމްގެ ތޫނު ލޮލުގައި އަޅައިގަތް.
shots.narration_english: On top of that, the pregnancy test kit lying on Shima's dressing table, which she had not dared to throw away, caught Qasim's sharp eye.

beats.new_image_reason: emotional turning point: Qasim's face red with rage, his whole body trembling
beats.location: Shima's bedroom in the wealthy house on a stormy night: a bed with a pale quilt, a dressing table with a mirror at the right, a window with a sheer curtain at the left with rain streaming down the glass, the bedroom door to the hallway
beats.mood: near-black blue storm night inside the room, a dim warm lamp, the cold glow of a phone, white lightning flashes through the window, dread
beats.visual: close-up of Qasim's face in the dark storm-lit room, his eyes wide and blazing, his face flushed red with fury, jaw clenched, the salt-and-pepper moustache trembling, the phone gripped in his shaking hand raised near his chest, its screen turned away; a white lightning flash behind him
beats.camera: close-up, slightly low angle, his face in the upper half, his shirt and shaking hand as the lower third

shots.narration_dhivehi: ޤާސިމްގެ ދެލޯ ބޮޑުވެ، މޫނުމަތި ރުޅިން ރަތްވެގެންދިޔަ. އޭނާގެ ހަށިގަނޑު ތުރުތުރުއަޅަން ފެށީ، އައިސްފައިވާ އިންތިހާ ދަރަޖައިގެ ރުޅީގެ ސަބަބުން.
shots.narration_english: Qasim's eyes widened and his face turned red with anger. His whole body began to tremble with the utmost fury that had come over him.

beats.camera: low angle close to the floor, the shattered phone in the middle, Qasim's legs and hand in the upper part, the tiles as the lower third

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަތުގައި އޮތް ފޯނު ބާރަށް ތަޅުމައްޗަށް ޖަހައި މުގުރާލި.
shots.narration_english: He hurled the phone in his hand down onto the floor and smashed it to pieces.
